translation_saheeh_international: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
translation_yusuf_ali: Except such as have Faith, and do righteous deeds, and (join together) in the mutual teaching of Truth, and of Patience and Constancy.
